name: Heraclean
description:
• While your world's overworld is thunderstorming, strikes that drop a [effect:boss][dark-gray]boss[/dark-gray][/effect] below any 25% health threshold detonate a large, [term:stun][dark-gray]stunning[/dark-gray][/term] [gold]tempest flare[/gold] for 10♥️ lightning damage.

  • Once per thunderstorm, each boss drops a [effect:tempest][blue]tempest chest[/blue][/effect] when slain, 10% of which contain their head.

effects.explanation:
Common: Squid & Glow Squid Ink, Prismarine Shards & Crystals, Weathered Copper
Uncommon: Potions of Luck, Bottles o' Enchanting, Nautilus Shell, Enchanted Books
Rare: Head of slain boss, Heart of the Sea, Twinkling Sea Crystals
